reuse.reason: Inspected the pinned official DSH account services: they manage DeepSeek Platform accounts, not SaaS product accounts or merchant infrastructure. Their Host contracts cannot implement confirmed newsletter and waitlist subscriptions. No corresponding official implementation can be mounted or forked. This independently authored Workers plugin composes existing HTTP and authentication services; it does not copy the purchased template or add app-entry behavior.
gaps: Resend is the selected contact provider. Ambiguous consent writes are durably locked until an administrator verifies the original request settled and reconciles real provider state. No broadcast scheduling, provider migration or automatic retry is implemented.
